data.standardized_narrative: Unable to extract a clear gross claims outstanding opening balance or a Gross prior-year reserve movement from the provided images. The managing agent's report pages are legible enough to read the gross written premium total for 2016, but the Balance Sheet / Technical Provisions notes and any explicit 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' lines are not sufficiently clear to extract a reliable gross reserves number or prior year development amount.
data.data_quality_notes: Document pages supplied as images are rotated and low-resolution in places. I could reliably read the Managing Agent summary table showing gross written premiums for 2016 (GBP 87,455,000) on page 4, but the Statement of Financial Position / Technical provisions pages and the 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note are not sufficiently legible to extract the gross claims outstanding at 1 January (opening reserves) or a gross prior-year development figure. Therefore opening_reserves_gbp_m and prior_year_development_gbp_m are null. No reliable gross segmental premium breakdown or gross claims development triangle could be extracted from the images provided.
